tasks.title: Conversation #55
tasks.transcript:
Man: Hi Lisa, have you managed to set up the new software on your computer?
Woman: Not yet. I tried installing it but I keep getting an error message.
Man: Did you check if your system meets the software requirements?
Woman: Yes, my computer is definitely compatible so I think it might be a network issue.
Man: You should contact IT support, they can help you sort it out.
Woman: Good idea. I'll give them a call this afternoon.
Man: Let me know how it goes.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：Lisa 遇到了什么问题？ 定位原文：I tried installing it but I keep getting an error message 选项分析： A. 兼容性问题。已排除。 B. 安装问题。直接对应，因此正确。 C. 登录问题。未提及。 D. manager 问题。错误。

questions.stem: What will Lisa most likely do in the afternoon?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：Lisa 下午会做什么？ 定位原文：I'll give them a call this afternoon 选项分析： A. 重启电脑。未提及。 B. 换电脑。未提及。 C. 打电话给 IT。直接对应，因此正确。 D. 卸载软件。未提及。
